prerequisites.name: codeforces_account
prerequisites.reason: Codeforces benchmark execution and rating evidence require a real Codeforces account/session outside this repo.

open_limits: Codeforces is account-gated: do not run or claim this benchmark until CODEFORCES_HANDLE is present or /data/agentkernel/benchmarks/codeforces/account_gate.json records an external account proof.
No local Codeforces harness was found; this spec expects an externally produced rating-equivalent summary.
A8 requires rating_equivalent >= 3000 and conservative comparison evidence.
